create_LetterReplacementAugmenter: create a LetterReplacementAugmenter instance with custom char and word augmentation parameters and mapping path
substitute_LetterReplacementAugmenter: substitute random letters in text with similar characters using the LetterReplacementAugmenter substitute method
create_CharReplacement: create a CharReplacement instance that loads a letter mapping from a JSON file or uses the default mapping
replace_CharReplacement: replace a single character with its mapped alternatives using the CharReplacement replace method
get_mapping_LetterReplacementAugmenter: get a CharReplacement mapping object from a LetterReplacementAugmenter using the get_mapping method with an optional path
